# PDFium notices

WindowsFS uses `bblanchon.PDFium.Win32` version `159.0.8152`, without V8 or XFA.
The native library is restored by NuGet; it is not stored in this repository.

The unmodified license files in this directory come from the matching upstream
[Chromium 8152 Windows x64 release](https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries/releases/tag/chromium/8152)
and are copied into the portable application's `third-party/pdfium` directory.

- Binary distribution: https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries
- PDFium source: https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/
- NuGet package: https://www.nuget.org/packages/bblanchon.PDFium.Win32/159.0.8152
